text:
-I made an appointment for this branch at 5:30 PM.

This is very confusing.
-I only need a filling. Is it impossible for any doctor to perform a filling right away? If that case takes another hour, I would have to waste another hour and pay for parking for nothing, even though I had booked in advance?

Otherwise, wouldn't it have been better to have booked the 6:00 PM slot in advance? I wouldn't have wasted time traveling so early.
-It wasted both time and parking fees. I wasn't a walk-in; I had made a reservation in advance.

text:
Throughout my orthodontic treatment, the doctor was incredibly attentive and caring. His advice was excellent. Not only is the doctor skilled, but his assistants are also exceptionally talented. I'm so happy with my experience. I wanted to share this review.

A friend recommended him. I saw my friend's teeth and decided to try it too. My teeth have been weak since childhood – crooked, decayed, crowded, impacted – over 10 teeth in total. My friend introduced me to Dr. Ek, and I went ahead with the treatment without hesitation.
I got my braces from Dr. Ek. I lacked confidence and was hesitant to choose the right treatment style; I didn't research much beforehand. My friends said my teeth looked beautiful (but mine looked like dog toenails, lol). Luckily, I found a very caring doctor. I trusted him completely because everyone's teeth are different. He never forced me to do anything; it was my choice. I believed it would turn out well, and it did! I commend the doctor immensely. It's no surprise the service is excellent. I'd give him 100 stars!
I hope this review is helpful for those deciding on orthodontic treatment. Thank you. 🙏🏻
